observed_execution_control_state.meaning: No real input read, S2 dispatch, manifest, ReviewReceipt, or grant is created or authorised by this design artifact.

admission_order.requirement: The frozen C01 preparation calendar SHA-256 and S1 label-audit SHA-256 exactly equal this matrix; any difference rejects before input access.
The proposed real-input scope is only trade_date 2021-01-01 through 2025-06-30; OOS, Final Holdout, raw data, derived bars, price caches, and trade records are excluded.
A human review explicitly grants a bounded exception for the closed F05/F06-adjacent C01 route. The current status is NOT_GRANTED.
A newly registered S2 task states one finite non-PnL attempt and its remaining budget. This task invents neither an attempt nor a remaining slot.
A complete non-PnL RunManifest and its ReviewReceipt exist for the new task and restrict input handling and outputs to this matrix. Neither artifact is created here.
A grant exactly matches the registered S2 task, frozen hashes, Development range, finite attempt, non-PnL output contract, manifest, and ReviewReceipt. The current grant count is zero.

decision_rule: Evaluate the gates in admission_order. Reject on the first missing, false, expired, mismatched, or out-of-scope condition. An ACCEPT_SYNTHETIC_ONLY result is a test fixture, never authority for real input access.
output_boundary: scheduled_date_count may count only the pre-scheduled calendar axis by S1 label. It must not report observed-bar, signal, order, fill, trade, return, or PnL counts.
